jobs.title: Junior Java Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Looking for enthusiastic freshers and entry-level Java developers with strong OOPs concepts and basic web development knowledge. Full training and mentor support will be provided during onboarding.
jobs.requirements: B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc Computers (2024, 2025 or 2026 batches). Basic knowledge of Core Java, SQL, and Git. Good problem-solving mindset and communication skills.

jobs.title: Customer Support Executive (Voice / Non-Voice)
jobs.description: Handle incoming customer queries for global banking and telecom clients. Day & rotational shifts available with free cab drop facility.
jobs.requirements: Any Graduate or 10+2 with good spoken English. Typing speed 25+ WPM. Freshers welcome with free communication training by UDJOG.

jobs.title: Banking Relationship Officer (CASA)
jobs.description: Responsible for acquisition of new retail banking customers, Current and Savings Account (CASA) operations, and cross-selling banking products.
jobs.requirements: Graduate in any stream (B.Com/BBA preferred). Basic banking knowledge, energetic customer interaction, and local language proficiency.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React / JavaScript)
jobs.description: Join a fast-growing SaaS team to build high-performance client dashboards and web applications with modern React architecture.
jobs.requirements: 1+ year experience or strong portfolio projects in React, responsive CSS, and state management. Strong debugging and UI sensibility.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
jobs.description: Connect with prospective clients, conduct product walkthroughs, build pipeline, and close corporate partnerships.
jobs.requirements: MBA / BBA / Any degree. Confident presentation and negotiation skills. Willingness to learn corporate sales.

jobs.title: Data Analyst Trainee
jobs.description: Analyze datasets, build automated reporting dashboards, and extract business insights for executive decision making.
jobs.requirements: Strong quantitative and analytical skills. Familiarity with SQL queries, Excel Pivot tables, and data visualization.

jobs.title: Finance & Accounts Executive
jobs.description: Manage daily ledger entries, vendor invoice verifications, GST return prep, and monthly reconciliation statements.
jobs.requirements: B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance. Practical knowledge of Tally and basic Indian GST regulations.

jobs.title: Technical Support Associate
jobs.description: Provide L1 technical troubleshooting for software installations, network setup, and IT service desk requests.
jobs.requirements: B.Sc Computers / Diploma / B.Tech. Good troubleshooting patience and customer service attitude.

candidates.message: Eager to join Java development team
